manifest.businessScope: The courier's working day in the Nesy Courier mobile app: signing in, taking a route, opening stops, processing parcels, completing deliveries and getting the tour approved.
notResponsibleFor: the dispatcher's own back-office UI — only the typed operations this pack calls as a second actor
